name: Dragonkin Berserker
oracle_text:
First strike
Boast abilities you activate cost {1} less to activate for each Dragon you control.
Boast — {4}{R}: Create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying. (Activate only if this creature attacked this turn and only once each turn.)
blocked_sentences: Boast abilities you activate cost {1} less to activate for each Dragon you control.

needs.what: a 'boast' ability class: an Ability.is_boast marker (set on activated abilities printed 'Boast — <cost>: <effect>', which carry the attacked-this-turn and once-each-turn restrictions) and a matching affects_abilities key {"boast": true} on ability_cost_reduction, so the static can discount every boast ability its controller activates by {1} per Dragon they control (amount {"count": {"controller": "you", "subtypes": ["Dragon"]}})
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ability_cost_reduction exists, but affects_abilities accepts only the classes in ABILITY_CLASS_KEYS (equip, any, non_mana); 'any' would discount every activated ability (and the loader demands a targeting clause with it), and the cost-node mana_reduction would only discount this card's own boast, not boast abilities on other permanents as printed. Nothing marks an ability as a boast ability
